decisionBox.changed: The single most important thing that changed is not on the chart. Friday's Farside row PUBLISHED, and it published POSITIVE: 04 September +174.6m net (IBIT +117.4m, FBTC +57.2m, every other fund flat). That was the explicit open question the endday session carried into the weekend, and it resolved in favour of the bulls. The 79,150.0 reduce was never approached: the session low was 79,449.5, 299.5 points of clearance, and the lowest settled hourly close was 79,500.1. The 79,900.0 add never armed: the highest settled close was 79,704.2 and the 79,719.9 session high fell 180.1 points short. The 78,950 resting stop was never within 499.5 points. Three further things moved AGAINST the endday bearish tilt. One: funding flipped NEGATIVE to -0.0000088287, or -0.00088 percent - shorts now pay longs, a reversal from the +0.00023 percent positive print at endday, which says the crowding by notional has quietly rotated to the short side even as the account ratio ticked up to 1.06. Two: realised long-liquidation dominance NARROWED from 3.21:1 to 2.99:1 (9,985,524 USD long against 3,343,970 short). Three: the open-interest bleed effectively STOPPED - down only 3,385,619 USD to 2,186,445,810 across the whole session, against -19,526,481 in the prior leg and -142,698,779 before that. Momentum is turning up underneath. The 1H MACD histogram has printed -39.31, -27.49, -13.46 - three consecutive improvements and converging on a positive cross - the 15m histogram is already positive at +16.17, and the 1H carries a clean regular BULLISH RSI divergence: the 04:00 low at 79,500.0 with RSI 43.62 was undercut by the 05:00 low at 79,449.5 on a HIGHER RSI of 45.36. Price is still below the 1H EMA20 at 79,744.28, the daily MACD histogram is still negative at -49.66, the 4H histogram is collapsing (148.32, 72.55, 11.75) toward its own negative cross, and roughly thirty hours of thin weekend book remain before Monday. Bias stays RANGE, but the tilt flips from bearish to BULLISH and the stance moves from REDUCE to ADD. The add is executed by HALVING the overnight short hedge from 30 to 15 USD notional rather than by buying spot - free cash is only 13.08 USDT and the weekend is not over, so residual protection stays on. The resting stop holds at 78,950.

calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates: 12 correct out of the last 13 evaluated sessions. Both endday gates were right by refusing to fire - the 79,150.0 reduce kept 299.5 points of clearance from the session low and the 79,900.0 add missed arming by 180.1 points on a high that never held. The single failure in the window remains the 03 September midday add gate placed below an untested high.
calibration.note: A correct session for the framework and a very slightly negative one for the discretionary book. Both endday gates refused to fire and both refusals were right, which is the fourth consecutive session in which a settled-close gate placed 0.5 hourly ATRs beyond a proven wick has correctly declined to arm on a touch. That is now a pattern with enough repetitions to be trusted, and it is why this report keeps the same 0.51-ATR spacing even though the ATR has contracted again. The discretionary side lost a rounding error. The endday session opened a 30 USD 2x short hedge at 79,656.8 to protect a spot core into the weekend gap; price then went UP 31.3 points, so the hedge cost roughly 0.012 USDT while the 0.00218887 BTC spot book gained about 0.069 USDT - net +0.057 USDT, but 0.012 worse than doing nothing. actingHelped is therefore false, and honestly so. The important calibration lesson is about the reasoning rather than the result. The hedge rested on three legs: an unknown Friday ETF flow, widening long-liquidation dominance and crowded longs. Within seven hours the first leg resolved AGAINST the thesis (+174.6m, positive), the second narrowed from 3.21:1 to 2.99:1, and funding flipped negative. When two of three premises weaken that fast, the correct response is to cut the position rather than defend it - which is what this session does by halving it. What kept it from being closed outright is that the third leg, the thin weekend book, is still fully intact for another thirty hours.
